description: MCP server for searching and fetching 6,500+ brand SVGs from thesvg.org

tools.description: Search for brand SVG icons from thesvg.org by name or slug. Returns matching icons with slug, name, variants, and categories. Use get_icon or get_icon_url to retrieve the actual SVG.

kind.description: Icon kind: 'brand' (default) or 'ui' for UI icons.

query.description: Brand name or partial slug to search for

tools.name: search_icons

tools.description: Fetch the raw SVG content for a specific brand icon from the jsDelivr CDN. Returns SVG markup, metadata, and the CDN URL.

kind.description: Icon kind: 'brand' (default) or 'ui' for UI icons.

look.description: UI icon look (kind 'ui' only): outline, glass, duotone, offset, fill, glass-outline, depth. Defaults to 'outline'.

slug.description: Icon slug identifier (e.g. 'github', 'stripe', 'openai'). Use search_icons to find slugs.

variant.description: Icon variant to fetch: 'default', 'mono', 'light', 'dark', 'wordmark', 'color'. Defaults to 'default'. Use list_variants to see what a specific icon supports.

tools.name: get_icon

tools.description: List all available variants for a specific brand icon. Variants may include: default, mono, light, dark, wordmark, wordmarkLight, wordmarkDark, color.

kind.description: Icon kind: 'brand' (default) or 'ui' for UI icons.

slug.description: Icon slug identifier (e.g. 'github', 'openai'). Use search_icons to find slugs.

tools.name: list_variants

tools.description: Get a jsDelivr CDN URL for a brand icon without fetching the SVG content. Use this to embed icons in HTML, Markdown, Notion, Webflow, or any img tag. Cheaper than get_icon when you only need the URL.

kind.description: Icon kind: 'brand' (default) or 'ui' for UI icons.

look.description: UI icon look (kind 'ui' only): outline, glass, duotone, offset, fill, glass-outline, depth. Defaults to 'outline'.

slug.description: Icon slug identifier (e.g. 'github', 'stripe', 'openai'). Use search_icons to find slugs.

tools.name: get_icon_url

tools.description: List all icon categories available in thesvg.org library with icon counts. Use this to discover what categories exist in the library and to inform follow-up search_icons queries.

kind.description: Icon kind: 'brand' (default) or 'ui' for UI icons.

tools.name: list_categories
